research_question: On one common GGUF/CUDA backend, does the frozen SG-MMP precision allocation provide a useful accuracy-memory-speed trade-off?
inference_scope: Deployment transferability of the frozen allocation policy; not deployment validation of the original GPTQ implementation.

llama_cpp.cuda_graphs: default enabled; GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS must be unset

pretest_amendments.trigger: The initial CUDA 11.6 build produced an intermittent boundary-tolerance failure in the pinned backend ADD test before any deployment artifact or task-quality row was generated.
pretest_amendments.resolution: Freeze CUDA Toolkit 12.4 with GCC/G++ 12 and require five consecutive ADD executions plus one complete backend execution on each physical RTX 3090, followed by the quantization-function test.
pretest_amendments.data_available_when_frozen: toolchain and official backend-test diagnostics only; no converted deployment artifacts, performance measurements, or GSM8K deployment results existed
pretest_amendments.scientific_scope: environment qualification only; method definitions, workload, endpoints, comparisons, stopping rules, and statistical analysis are unchanged

pretest_amendments.trigger: The CUDA 12.4 qualification attempt showed that the same randomized fused-F16 ADD case can exceed the upstream 1e-7 NMSE threshold by 1 percent while every other backend test passes; the pinned and current upstream test sources initialize this case from std::random_device.
pretest_amendments.resolution: Keep every prespecified execution and disclose strict-pass counts. A nonzero execution is gate-accepted only when its sole listed failure is the exact frozen fused-F16 ADD signature, the reported NMSE is at most 2e-7, exactly one test failed, and no graph comparison failed. Any other failure remains fatal. Production artifacts still require the separate train-only CPU-versus-CUDA continuation gate.
pretest_amendments.data_available_when_frozen: two toolchain qualification logs only; no converted deployment artifacts, performance measurements, or GSM8K deployment results existed
pretest_amendments.scientific_scope: qualification interpretation only; upstream/runtime binaries, model artifacts, workloads, endpoints, comparisons, stopping rules, and statistical analysis are unchanged
pretest_amendments.status: withdrawn before use; no artifact or result was admitted under this exception

pretest_amendments.trigger: Methodological review rejected a post-hoc tolerance for a randomized generic upstream unit test that is not the scientific comparison target.
pretest_amendments.resolution: Remove the generic test-backend-ops suite from experimental eligibility and remove the proposed 2e-7 exception. Retain all historical diagnostic attempts. Require the pinned toolchain and test-quantize-fns to pass strictly; require the FP16 conversion to pass the frozen HF-versus-GGUF token and log-probability checks; and require every actual FP16, Q4, Q5, and SG artifact to pass the frozen train-only CPU-versus-CUDA continuation gate.
pretest_amendments.data_available_when_frozen: toolchain and upstream diagnostic logs only; no converted deployment artifacts, performance measurements, or GSM8K deployment results existed
pretest_amendments.scientific_scope: replaces a generic randomized implementation diagnostic with artifact-specific validation; model definitions, workloads, endpoints, comparisons, stopping rules, and statistical analysis are unchanged

pretest_amendments.trigger: The first engineering imatrix launch exited with SIGFPE before producing an importance matrix because the wrapper passed output-frequency=0 to an upstream modulo operation.
pretest_amendments.resolution: Use the documented output frequency 10, retain the documented save frequency 0, and write to an incomplete GGUF path that is atomically promoted only after a successful nonempty result. Failed staging output is removed while the append-only command log is retained.
pretest_amendments.data_available_when_frozen: the audited source FP16 GGUF artifact only; no importance matrix, quantized deployment artifact, performance measurement, or GSM8K deployment result existed
pretest_amendments.scientific_scope: crash and partial-file repair only; calibration corpus, importance computation, quantization policy, workloads, endpoints, comparisons, stopping rules, and statistical analysis are unchanged

pretest_amendments.trigger: The first engineering Q4 artifact failed the exact tensor-type audit before any packed-backend gate, benchmark, or GSM8K deployment result. The pinned llama.cpp source deterministically falls back from Q4_K to Q5_0 and from Q5_K to Q5_1 when a tensor row is not divisible by the 256-element K-quant block; Qwen2.5-0.5B contains eligible tensors with such dimensions.
pretest_amendments.resolution: Reject and preserve the failed Q4_K artifact, and replace the deployment formats with 32-element-block Q4_0-pure and Q5_0-pure. SG allocation-GGUF uses the identical Q4_0 base plus only the exact frozen Q8_0 module overrides. Every eligible tensor must now match Q4_0, Q5_0, or its prescribed Q8_0 type exactly; no structural fallback is accepted.
pretest_amendments.data_available_when_frozen: the audited source FP16 artifact, the train-only importance matrix, and the failed Q4_K tensor audit only; no accepted packed artifact, packed-backend gate, performance measurement, or GSM8K deployment result existed
pretest_amendments.scientific_scope: pre-result format-feasibility correction that makes the nominal Q4 and Q5 controls exact and auditable; high-precision sources, frozen SG allocation, importance data, workloads, endpoints, stopping rules, and statistical analysis are unchanged

pretest_amendments.trigger: The first train-only Qwen2.5-0.5B conversion gate found 8/8 tokenizer matches and 8/8 top-8 overlap on seven prompts (7/8 on one), but one near-tied first-token ordering change amplified into a 16-token free-running divergence; a separate low-ranked token exceeded the 0.05 log-probability bound by 0.000110 while both backends retained the same decisive top token. No deployment benchmark or GSM8K test result existed.
pretest_amendments.resolution: Align the implementation with the preapproved conversion-validation scope: pass identical effective prompt token IDs and identical HF-greedy histories to both backends, compare teacher-forced top-8 reference distributions at all 128 prompt/position cells, retain the original 0.05 bound for decision-critical tokens, and permit a top-1 swap only when both candidates are each backend's top two and both margins are at most twice that numerical bound. Keep free-running continuation agreement as a reported diagnostic rather than an eligibility criterion.
pretest_amendments.data_available_when_frozen: audited FP16/Q4_0/Q5_0/SG engineering artifacts and one failed eight-prompt train-only conversion diagnostic; no packed-backend acceptance, performance measurement, or GSM8K deployment test result existed
pretest_amendments.scientific_scope: conversion fidelity is tested on matched input/history logits without autoregressive cascade; tokenizer identity and numerical tolerance are not relaxed, and task quality remains separately remeasured under the frozen full-test protocol

source_weights: Each artifact is independently quantized from the immutable high-precision checkpoint recorded by revision-full-v4; requantization is forbidden.

sg.label: SG allocation-GGUF
sg.quantizer: llama-quantize --pure with exact frozen-module Q8_0 overrides

importance_matrix.source: Round-trip-exact decoded union, in seed order 41/97/193, of the existing frozen WikiText-train packed calibration streams; independent sequences are separated by one model EOS token parsed as special
importance_matrix.sequence_boundary: one model EOS token; 383 boundaries for 384 frozen sequences
importance_matrix.publication: write to an incomplete GGUF path and atomically promote only after successful nonempty completion

tensor_policy.output_head: F16 when stored; an absent tied output is recorded, not duplicated
tensor_policy.normalization_and_other_noneligible_tens: unchanged conversion/default treatment, audited per artifact
tensor_policy.mapping_requirement: Every eligible HF module maps exactly once to GGUF and has the prescribed Q4_0, Q5_0, or selected Q8_0 type; missing, duplicate, shape/parameter, structural-fallback, or type mismatches hard fail.
tensor_policy.budget_policy: Do not retune the frozen SG selection to match Q5 bytes. Report original logical bpw, packed eligible bpw, whole-artifact bpw, and exact bytes separately.

quality.dataset: complete official GSM8K test set in dataset order

performance.backend: one pinned llama.cpp CUDA build for every method

fixed_controls.quality_gpu: the other RTX 3090; no simultaneous timing workload

performance.formal_precision_target: For SG/Q4 and SG/Q5 native-service aggregate-throughput ratios at concurrency 1 and 4, require 95% paired process-block bootstrap ratio CI half-width <= 2%; add paired blocks 10->20->30, then stop and report even if unmet.

conversion.data: eight fixed GSM8K-train prompts at indices 5..12; test is never loaded
conversion.tokenizer: 8/8 prompt token-ID arrays exactly match Hugging Face with add_special_tokens=false
conversion.chat_template: for chat models, 8/8 rendered prompt strings and token arrays are recorded and must pass the tokenizer rule
conversion.effective_input: The Hugging Face effective prompt token IDs, including its frozen special-token behavior, are recorded and passed directly to llama-server for every numerical comparison.
conversion.teacher_forced_reference_logits: Across all 8 prompts x 16 HF-greedy reference positions, raw HF-FP16 and GGUF-FP16 next-token top-8 sets overlap on at least 7 IDs and every token in the union of both top-2 sets differs by at most 0.05 absolute log-probability. EOS is not suppressed for this one-step distribution query. A top-1 swap is accepted only when both candidates are in both top-2 sets and both top-1 margins are at most 0.10, the pairwise uncertainty implied by the unchanged per-token bound.
conversion.free_running_continuation: The 8 x 16 greedy continuation agreement is recorded as an autoregressive-amplification diagnostic and is not an eligibility condition.

packed_backend.official_tests: With CUDA Toolkit 12.4 and G++ 12, test-quantize-fns must pass strictly before artifact construction. The randomized generic test-backend-ops suite is not an experimental eligibility gate; its earlier attempts remain preserved as diagnostics and no numerical exception is active.
packed_backend.data: the same eight fixed GSM8K-train prompts; test is never loaded
packed_backend.continuation: CPU versus CUDA for every packed artifact: 8/8 first generated tokens and at least 126/128 aligned greedy continuation tokens match

gates.artifact: Every tensor mapping/type/size audit passes and provenance hashes are complete.
gates.stage_progression: Engineering qwen05 is technical only. Value qwen15+smollm is precommitted. Within every test-bearing stage, every model must finish artifact construction, gates, and performance blocks before any GSM8K test row is loaded. Formal expansion requires passed gates, <=24 estimated GPU-hours, and <=40 GiB estimated additional storage.

statistics.within_process_repetitions: summarized within block; never treated as independent replicates
statistics.comparison: paired by process block; report the geometric mean of within-block method ratios with deterministic paired bootstrap confidence intervals
statistics.accuracy: paired item-level effects and intervals within each newly measured backend artifact

claim_policy.allowed: Allocation-policy transfer on this pinned GGUF/CUDA stack, with measured accuracy, storage, memory, and speed.
forbidden: Calling the new artifacts original GPTQ-W4/W5 or original SG-MMP weights
Claiming Q5 is slow merely because INT5 is not a native Tensor Core type
Using llama-bench as end-to-end TTFT or service throughput
Mixing original logical bit budget with packed file bits-per-weight
Enabling the revision-full deployment claim from this extension
